text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I am an Umamusume of the Mejiro
family... And
like the others, that's been
a biiig part of my life
since I was little.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We were raised listening to wonderful

stories—tales of our older Mejiro sisters'
exploits.
They were the stuff of dreams
and legends.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Down Mount Yotei and through heavy
snow, our
founder trekked.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thus, awoke the "mother mountain," and
the
earth was saturated with love, giving
birth to the
"giants."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At last, all her children opened their
eyes for the
first time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro Umamusume ran, swift as the
wind
across grassy fields, valleys of
flowers, deserts,
and snowy plains.
Until...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They ran in races, where they stirred the
hearts of
many with excitement and
emotion, bringing
smiles to their faces.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Like so, the Mejiro Umamusume had
become
children of light, admired by all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(And this is why we've always dreamed
that
someday we, too, would become
wonderful big
sisters like they were.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(For if we are all children of light, then
each of us
should harbor that Mejiro
glimmer.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(That is what our dear, esteemed
grandmother
told us.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Of course, each one of you excels in a
different
manner.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to build upon the Mejiro
name, you
must capitalize on what
makes you strong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, you are to run in
long-distance races.
Ryan, you must
polish your movements.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Ardan, steel that firm resolve of yours.
Palmer,
refine your willpower.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Dober, embolden your heart. And
Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes, Grandmother? What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text: You... must watch everyone closely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I must... watch? Oh... Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text: That is all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(I believe that I, too, am a child of light,
just as
they are. And yet, this is what I
was told by the
Mejiro family.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
("You needn't run. Observe from the
sidelines.")

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Spring came. The spring I yearned for
arrived. I
entered Tracen Academy,
and...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer. I look forward to
working with
you from today onwards.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is why... I would like you to guide
me there.
Please, will you join me in
welcoming the spring?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You got it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(All because I've happened upon a
trainer who's
willing to guide me and
walk beside me at my
pace.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's here... My true spring is finally about
to begin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's happening, Trainer. My
long-awaited
debut in the Twinkle Series
is set.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely. Um, pardon me, but I'm
wondering...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When will I actually be able to
participate in the
Twinkle Series itself?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh? Well, yes, that does make sense.
Very
well, then.
choice_data_list: もちろんメイクデビューを終えたら……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Henceforth, I shall commit every fiber of
my
being to racing and do the Mejiro
name proud.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My trainee is Mejiro Bright, an
Umamusume from
the prestigious Mejiro
family. But the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a wonderful day... La, la,
laaa... ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even for a pampered young lady, she's

extraordinarily laid-back. As well as
being slow
out of the gate, she's also
slow to take action
mid-race. That said...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Once I hear the signal, I'll pick up the pace... I just need to be ready—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pant... Right! Here... I go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ever since I was a child—aaall this time—I've been disappointing those who have had high expectations of me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, I
ought
to be ashamed of myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I must become a new light for the Mejiro
family!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not that she wants for drive or
talent—she just
has trouble with
adjusting to the flow and seizing
the
moment to act.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I show her when to take action, she'll
be able to
close the gaps—both on and
off the racetrack...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In addition to Mejiro Bright, another
Mejiro is
debuting as her peer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We've finally arrived, Bright. At long
last, we've
reached the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Dober, welcome! And yes, we have
indeed. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Mejiro Dober. She's
another
member of the Mejiro family and
a composed
runner. On top of that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, Bright's trainer... Hello...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's extremely shy and shows no signs
of
warming up to me, even now that I'm
Mejiro
Bright's trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's both do our best, Dober. Also...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's be sure to bring honor to the
Mejiro name,
just as McQueen and Ryan
have before us...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa. I just dropped by to see how
you were
doing, but... hearing you put
me on a pedestal
like that—I'm blushing
here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But this is awesome, you guys—both of
you
debuting in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And you must be Bright's trainer! Keep
an eye on
her for me, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Mejiro Ryan. Adored by
Mejiro
Bright, she's one of the Mejiro
family's exemplary
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As for what makes Mejiro Ryan so
strong...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I really do strive to be like you, Ryan. If
only I
could close in on the opposition
with your force
and momentum...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Come to think of it, you always
did like
the way I speed up on the last
stretch, huh,
Bright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, you should try that too!
Knowing you,
you could probably pull it
off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Bright's got nice,
long legs,
just like Ryan. Maybe Ryan's
the one who inspired
her running style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family doesn't seem to have
much
hope for Bright, but even so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. Let's move forward
together,
hand in hand...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The sunlight shining through the foliage
is ever so
bright. I may be in the shade
now, but no matter
what, I shall become
the light of the Mejiro
family!
